treatment_setting_evidence.quote: New diagnoses of glioblastoma IDH wild type.

To evaluate the effect of Niacin CRT in peripheral monocytes by comparing control monocytoid cells to those that have been treated with Niacin.

role_evidence.quote: Niacin CRT™ is to be started 7 days before concurrent Radiation Therapy (RT)- Temozolomide (TMZ) treatment.

agents.drug_class_hint: niacin (vitamin B3), lipid-lowering agent; controlled-release tablet

flag.reason: Licensed medicine also sold as a supplement (vitamin B3); per manual 1.2 flagged for adjudication of candidate status.

role_evidence.quote: For all patients, regardless of the phase of the study, concurrent RT and TMZ for 6 weeks followed by 6-12 cycles of monthly TMZ will be given.

source_quote.quote: New diagnoses of glioblastoma IDH wild type.

coder_notes: INN for niacin is nicotinic acid (used as active moiety). Formulation flag new_formulation because the record specifies a controlled-release technology (CRT) tablet; extended-release niacin already exists, so this may be 'none' on adjudication. Temozolomide is not a registered intervention but every patient receives Stupp RT/TMZ, so soc_backbone. Target engagement: planned pharmacodynamic assessment of niacin activity in peripheral blood monocytes/innate immune cells (blood PD), no tumour PD. No antitumour mechanism stated explicitly (only implied immune effect on innate cells). IDH-wildtype is diagnostic, not candidate-matched.
